title: Have to reset "Number Icon in Notification Area" upon phone reboot
symptom: After a phone reboot, the number icon in the notification area shows a blood drop icon instead of the numerical BG, requiring the user to toggle the setting off and on again to restore it.
cause: The number icon feature has a safety check that prevents it from starting until about 15 minutes after a phone reboot, to avoid crashing Android on buggy phones.
fix: Wait about 15 minutes after reboot for the feature to start, or toggle the setting off and on (sometimes twice) and force stop the app to make it work immediately.
settings_changed: Number Icon in Notification Area → off then on
evidence_quote: The number icon in notification area has a safety check on it that it wont start the feature until something like 15 minutes after a phone reboot.
